notes: SecondQuest Production Standard. English is the production and default output language; Spanish (and any other locale) is optional and only produced/rendered on explicit request (--locale <code>). New episodes are scaffolded from these values.

render.policy: Renders use defaultLocale unless --locale is passed explicitly. Non-default locales are never rendered as part of the normal flow.

es.name: SecondQuest Spanish Voice v1
es.note: Native Kokoro embedding blend: 40% am_michael + 60% em_alex (weighted sum of the style tensors). Spanish is an optional locale, produced/rendered only on explicit request (--locale es).
